notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers Cloudflare R2 bucket and object management with Wrangler, S3-compatible access via the AWS CLI and boto3, Worker bindings and a sample Worker, presigned URLs (boto3 and aws4fetch), public bucket access, and lifecycle and CORS rules via the Cloudflare API.

Medium: following it has the agent install Wrangler globally with npm, authenticate with the user's Cloudflare/R2 credentials (wrangler login, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, an aws CLI profile), create and delete buckets and objects, `aws s3 rm --recursive` a prefix, and PUT lifecycle/CORS configs to api.cloudflare.com with $CF_API_TOKEN. Acceptable because these are standard operations on the user's own Cloudflare account; the deletions (SKILL.md:44, 62, 111) are reference commands with example names and should be run only on user request.

Users should know: the sample Worker (SKILL.md:169-222) accepts unauthenticated PUT and DELETE requests, so add authentication before deploying it; the lifecycle example auto-deletes tmp/ and logs/ objects. Credentials are placeholders (<R2_ACCESS_KEY>, <ACCOUNT_ID>). Related Skills (SKILL.md:335-337) link to sibling skills ../cloudflare-workers/, ../cloudflare-pages/, ../../networking/cdn-setup/ as optional reading only.
